messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: stan: problem with stan-snippets for emacs
parts:
Hi!

I had similar issues, I am using the MELPA version. I just added

(setq stan--load-auto-complete t)

to my .emacs file and then things worked, so I didn't bother any longer.

Sebastian
